rationale: The program defines the InputIterator class (req_01). It implements load_iterator to handle file paths and dictionary-like sources, returning an iterator over their contents (req_02). The __init__ method accepts a fail_on_missing parameter which controls whether a FileNotFoundError is raised or an empty iterator is returned when a file is missing (req_03). The class includes from_json as a classmethod to create an instance from JSON (req_04) and to_json to serialize the instance back to JSON (req_05). All requirements are met.
